info.title: Tech Stack Detector: Website Technology Lookup
info.description:
Find what any website is built with: CMS, frameworks, analytics, CDN, hosting and more.

Runs on your own Apify account (pay-per-use). Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/tech-stack-detector
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/tech-stack-detector
Author: Public Records.
